subtitle: Xhuma iziqhingi ngamabhuloho
short_description: Xhuma iziqhingi ezinombolo ngamabhuloho ukuze inombolo ngayinye ihlangabezwe.
description:
Xhuma iziqhingi ezinombolo ngamabhuloho aqondile angu-0, angu-1 noma angu-2, ukuze iqhingi ngalinye libe nenombolo yalo kuphela, amabhuloho angaqambi, futhi zonke iziqhingi zihlanganiswe zibe yinethiwekhi eyodwa.

Thepha iqhingi elilodwa bese uthepha elinye ukuze ushintshe ibhuloho phakathi kwawo. Izinkinobho ezinkulu zezinhlamvu zeziqhingi zinikeza enye indlela esikhundleni sokuthepha ngokunembile ebhodini.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
